scope: All papers whose datasets field was empty at the start of this audit.
policy: Record named datasets and benchmarks used directly for training, validation or evaluation in the primary paper. Related-work mentions, unnamed private collections, reused baseline checkpoints and custom simulations are not treated as datasets. Evidence links point to the paper or the supporting section.
